rule: Refuse the link when the only discriminator available is name, ticker or image. Impostor deploys copy all three within minutes of a narrative opening.

evidence.note: bound the impostor; the real deploy was 20 minutes older

rule: When two candidate contracts both survive the discriminators, emit ambiguous rather than picking the one with more volume. Bought volume is an impostor's cheapest disguise.
Collapse accounts sharing a funding root to a single node before scoring, never after. A score computed on fifty nodes and then divided is not the same number.

evidence.note: fifty mouths, one funder, entered at four times fair weight

rule: Treat an endorsement with no named object as no endorsement, at any authority level. Posting near a topic is not endorsing anything in it.

evidence.note: would not have changed this one

rule: Do not enter below the band. The opening tax is charged before conviction is, and arriving earlier on a chain with no gas auction only buys a worse fill.

evidence.note: entered 9 minutes early, paid 71% to the decaying tax

rule: Treat INCONCLUSIVE exactly as REJECT at the point of decision. A hard check that timed out has not been passed; it has not run.

evidence.note: RPC timeout on sellable, token was a honeypot

rule: Halve size on PASS_WITH_FLAGS rather than entering full with a note. A flag you size through is a flag you did not act on.

evidence.note: half size cost upside on a clean runner

rule: Do not re-enter on a narrative you already laddered out of. The narrative closed when the position did; a new entry needs new evidence under a new id.

evidence.note: re-entered the same story 40% higher, round-tripped it
